question: The part of the Himalayas lying between Satluj and __________ rivers is known as Kumaon Himalayas.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kali.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Kumaon Himalayas** lie between the **Satluj river** in the **west **and the** Kali river **in the** east.**
 
• The Kali river forms the boundary between** India and Nepal. **
 
• The Kumaon region is known for its scenic beauty, trekking trails
